description: This image is not a scientific data figure. It is a publisher's "Check for updates" badge (the Crossref update-alert logo): a circular ring on a light grey-to-lavender gradient background, the ring split into a blue arc (upper/right) and a yellow arc (lower/left), enclosing a red ribbon or bookmark shape whose lower edge is notched into a shallow V. Directly beneath the ring, two lines of black sans-serif text read "Check for" over "updates". There are no axes, no units, no scale bar, no legend, no data points, no spectra, no micrograph and no sample or condition labels anywhere in the image; the only printed strings are the two words of the badge text. The paper title ("Low-density and high-modulus steel achieved by hypereutectic TiB2 and high Al ferrite phase") and the abstract supplied with this group describe a lightweight-steel study, but nothing in these pixels depicts or supports that content. Either the figure was mis-cropped or a placeholder/asset image was substituted for the intended figure panel. No scientific claim, trend, phase, composition or measurement can be extracted from this image, and no linkage to any other panel exists because no other panel is present.
